objective: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

description: The tablet is covered with Witherbark troll markings. Rin'ji's secret truly is a mystery...

It's possible that you might have something quite valuable on your hands here. On the other hand, quite the opposite is also possible. A Witherbark troll in distress would probably do anything to find his way out of trouble...
completion: This tablet... Quite unusual... Where did you find this, <name>?
